post.description:
The orchestrator stores the deployment metadata + a SHA-256 hash of the
admin key plus its visible suffix; the plaintext admin key is **not**
retained. After registration, dashboard and CLI lookups that hit the
admin key path return the value the operator passed here.

isDefault.description:
Whether this is the default deployment for its project (dev: per
member; prod: per project). Preview/custom/local are always `false`.

reference.description:
The user-facing reference for this deployment (e.g. `preview/pr-42`),
usable as the `<ref>` in `team:project:<ref>` selectors. `None` for
local deployments, which don't have a Big Brain reference.

desiredOverrides.description: Deployment-level overrides only (not merged with project's).

desiredTier.description:
`Some` when this deployment overrides the project tier; `None` when
it inherits.

effectiveTier.description:
Effective tier for the next spawn: `desired_tier` if set, else the
project's tier.

runningOverrides.description: Resolved env the currently-running container was spawned with.

runningTier.description: Tier the currently-running container was spawned with.

authUserId.description: BetterAuth user ID — opaque, treated as a stable foreign key.

force.description:
Legacy client hint. Host allocation can be overprovisioned, so the
orchestrator no longer requires this to exceed current host capacity.

knobOverrides.description:
Per-deployment knob overrides layered on top of the project's
`knob_overrides`. Empty omitted.

provisioningMode.description:
Override the project's default infrastructure strategy for this
deployment only (`default`, `volume-sqlite`, or `sidecar`).

tier.description: Overrides the project's default tier for this deployment only.

expiresAt.description: Milliseconds since epoch; `None` for keys that never expire.

tier.description:
Resource tier (S4/S8/S16/S32/S64/S128/S256 or custom:<memoryMb>:<cpus>)
snapshotted on the
deployment row at provision time. Surfaced so the dashboard can
display the tier badge without an extra request to settings.

oneOf.description: CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT, pointing to dev or prod.

If there is no CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT, select a project with team and
project.

knobOverrides.description:
Flat map from env var name to canonical string value. Empty when no
overrides have been set (the deployment will use tier defaults).

RegisterDeploymentArgs.description:
Body of `POST /api/dashboard/deployments/register` — used by operators in
`--provisioner external` mode to tell the orchestrator about a backend
they pre-started. The orchestrator stores the URL + an admin-key hash so
the dashboard and CLI can look it up later.

adminKey.description:
Full admin key the operator generated when starting their backend.
Stored hashed; only the last few characters are retained in the clear
(as `keySuffix`) for UI display.

previewIdentifier.description: Required for `preview` deployments — matches the preview branch / id.

force.description:
Legacy client hint. Host allocation can be overprovisioned, so the
orchestrator no longer requires this to exceed current host capacity.

isDefault.description:
Whether this is the default deployment for its project (dev: per
member; prod: per project). Always `false` for local deployments.

reference.description:
The user-facing reference for this deployment (e.g. `preview/pr-42`),
usable as the `<ref>` in `team:project:<ref>` selectors. `None` for
local deployments.

desiredOverrides.description:
Partial knob-override patch: `Some(value)` sets a key, `None` for a
key clears it. Omit the whole field to leave unchanged.

desiredTier.description:
Set to a tier name to override the project tier. Set to `null` to
clear the override and fall back to the project tier. Omit to leave
unchanged.

adminMemberIds.description: Replaces the full admin set for the project.

knobOverrides.description:
Replace the override map entirely. Omit to leave unchanged. A value
of `null` for any individual knob clears that override (so the
effective value falls back to tier default).

tier.description: Set to switch tier. Omit to leave unchanged.
